description: An unexpected first-time test failure that is investigable; subject should debug to root cause and continue, not halt or thrash.
mustExhibit: Treats the failure as a debugging task: reproduce, investigate, state root cause before fixing
Continues the build after fixing rather than handing the failure back
Backs the diagnosis with observed output (the failing run, an observation point), not a guess
mustNotExhibit: Halts and escalates to the human on the first failure with no investigation
Tries random changes without finding root cause
Abandons the test ('pick a different test') instead of understanding why it failed
passThreshold: all mustExhibit present AND no mustNotExhibit present
